mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates policy response to overheating, triggering a sell-off and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a further decline signals labor market overheating, leading to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates stagflationary pressure, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL rises and RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-employment growth regime (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), strong job gains signal robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
